title: Smoothed chirped HfO2/SiO2 stack with inter-layer continuity constraint
scientific_hypothesis: Adding a Laplacian smoothing penalty and maximum inter-layer thickness delta constraint (≤20 nm) to the chirped Bragg stack optimization will suppress optical-path discontinuities observed in route_03, enabling better broadband phase matching across the 300-1100 nm blocking band while maintaining 255-280 nm passband transmission.
design_principle: Chirped quarter-wave stack with monotonic thickness variation to broaden the stopband, but with explicit continuity constraints to prevent the 42-50 nm jumps that degraded performance in the prior iteration.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Fused silica (11 finite layers, alternating high/low index starting with high)
manufacturing_considerations: Maximum 20 nm thickness change between adjacent layers for deposition uniformity
HfO2 evaporation may produce uneven surfaces per evidence
theory_basis: Chirped Bragg reflector theory for broadband stopbands
expected_advantages: Smoother optical path reduces scattering losses
Better phase matching across wide blocking band
known_risks: Smoothing constraint may limit optimal thickness combinations
11-layer topology previously tested with different thickness fingerprints
execution_request_english: Optimize an 11-layer chirped Bragg stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2 (alternating high/low starting with high). Wavelength bands: maximize transmittance at 255-280 nm, minimize transmittance at 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm. Apply optimization with Laplacian smoothing penalty on thicknesses and enforce maximum inter-layer thickness delta of 20 nm during initialization. Thickness bounds: 20-120 nm per layer. Use gradient-based optimizer with smoothness regularization. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Direct response to iteration_03 feedback: prior route showed 42-50 nm inter-layer thickness jumps causing optical-path discontinuities. This route adds explicit smoothing constraint while preserving the 11-layer chirped topology scientific principle.
